title: Welcome
lede: A quick setup so watching streams works the first time.
streamlinkMissingTitle: Streamlink is required to watch streams
streamlinkMissingBody: Streamlink pulls the Twitch stream and sends it to your player. Install it, then click Recheck. Release builds can also ship a bundled copy — set Streamlink to Bundled in Settings.
playerMissingBody: mpv is recommended. Install it, then click Recheck. You can pick another player later in Settings.
loginBody: Logging in unlocks followed streams and personalized features. You can browse top streams after signing in, or skip and do this later.
